# TDEE Check

> TDEE Check is a free calculator site that helps people find their Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) and the calories they need to lose, maintain, or gain weight. All tools are free, need no sign up, and run instantly in the browser. Content is reviewed by Farah Akram, a dietitian.

## Calculators

- [TDEE Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/): Find your maintenance calories with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, with cut, bulk and maintenance targets and macro splits.
- [BMR Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/bmr-calculator/): Your basal metabolic rate, the calories your body burns at complete rest.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/calorie-calculator/): Daily calorie targets for losing, maintaining, or gaining weight.
- [Macro Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/macro-calculator/): Daily protein, carbohydrate and fat grams for your calorie target and goal.
- [BMI Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/bmi-calculator/): Body mass index with the standard adult weight categories.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/calorie-deficit-calculator/): Four deficit sizes with safe daily targets, projected weekly loss and goal weight timelines.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/water-intake-calculator/): Your daily water target in liters, milliliters, ounces and glasses, from your weight and exercise time.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/lean-body-mass-calculator/): Lean body mass from the Boer and James formulas, or from your body fat percentage, with fat mass.
- [FFMI Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/ffmi-calculator/): Fat free mass index, raw and normalized, scored on the classic scale up to the natural limit.
- [Army Body Fat Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/army-body-fat-calculator/): Body fat percentage by the US Army circumference method, checked against the standards for your age group.
- [Pregnancy Calorie Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/pregnancy-calorie-calculator/): Maintenance calories plus the extra energy needed in trimester one, two and three.
- [Breastfeeding Calorie Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/calculators/breastfeeding-calorie-calculator/): Maintenance calories plus the milk production allowance for babies under and over 6 months.
- [TDEE Weight Loss Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/tdee-weight-loss-calculator/): The safe calorie deficit and weekly loss rate for your body and activity level.

## TDEE variants

- [TDEE Calculator for Women](https://tdeecheck.com/tdee-calculator-for-women/): The TDEE calculator with the female Mifflin-St Jeor equation preset, cycle aware guidance and the 1,200 kcal safety floor.
- [TDEE Calculator for Men](https://tdeecheck.com/tdee-calculator-for-men/): The TDEE calculator with the male equation preset, typical male TDEE ranges, bulking targets and the 1,500 kcal floor.
- [TDEE Calculator (KG)](https://tdeecheck.com/tdee-calculator-kg/): The TDEE calculator opening in kilograms and centimeters, the formula shown purely in metric, with pound and stone conversions.
- [Sedentary TDEE Calculator](https://tdeecheck.com/sedentary-tdee-calculator/): The TDEE calculator with activity fixed at the sedentary 1.2 level for desk workers, plus NEAT strategies to raise daily burn.

## Guides

- [How to Calculate Your TDEE: A Step by Step Guide](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/how-to-calculate-tdee/): The formula, a worked example, activity multipliers and the mistakes that skew results.
- [TDEE vs BMR: What Is the Difference and Which Do You Need?](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/tdee-vs-bmr/): BMR is the resting floor, TDEE is the full day. How the two connect, a worked example, and which number to eat to.
- [How Accurate Are TDEE Calculators? (And How to Fix Your Number)](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/how-accurate-are-tdee-calculators/): Formulas land within about 10 percent for most people. Where the error hides and the 2 to 3 week test that finds your true TDEE.
- [What Is a Calorie Deficit? Sizes, Safety and a Worked Example](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/what-is-a-calorie-deficit/): The four deficit sizes compared, the 3,500 kcal rule explained as an approximation, safety floors and a step by step build.
- [What Is a Good TDEE? Average TDEE by Age, Sex and Activity](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/average-tdee/): Typical TDEE ranges for women and men at four activity levels, how age lowers the number, and why your own tested figure matters more than any average.
- [How to Use TDEE for Weight Loss: The Safe Deficit Guide](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/tdee-for-weight-loss/): The step by step method: find maintenance, choose a 250 to 500 kcal deficit, set protein, track and adjust, with safety floors and plateau fixes.
- [Why Your TDEE Changed: 7 Reasons Your Number Moves](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/why-your-tdee-changed/): Weight change, muscle, step drift, aging, adaptive thermogenesis, sleep and water weight: why maintenance calories move and when to recalculate.
- [TDEE for Beginners: The Complete Plain-Language Guide](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/tdee-for-beginners/): TDEE and BMR in plain words, the activity multiplier, a tiny glossary, one worked example and three things to do in your first week.
- [Eating Below Your BMR: Is It Safe?](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/eating-below-your-bmr/): What BMR pays for, why chronic intake below it backfires, who must never do it, and how to take your deficit from TDEE instead.
- [How Activity Levels Really Work (and Why Most People Overestimate)](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/how-activity-levels-work/): The five multipliers read as jobs and step counts, NEAT explained, a step based self-test, and the cost of picking one level too high.
- [Reverse Dieting Explained: Raising Calories After a Diet](https://tdeecheck.com/blog/reverse-dieting-explained/): Adding 50 to 150 kcal a week after a diet, what the scale does at first, how long it takes, and when to jump straight to maintenance.
